name: ui_timeline_add_group
description: Create a group clip: a clip with no media of its own whose transform, opacity and window every clip naming it inherits. Move the group and its children move with it; fade the group and they fade together; a child outside the group's window is not drawn. Children keep their own tracks, so what covers what is unchanged. Pass `children` to parent clips as the group is created, or use ui_timeline_set_parent afterwards.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

durationMs.description: How long the window stays open. A child is clipped to it, so cover the children.

trackId.description: Track for the group clip, by id or name. Defaults to an overlay track, creating one when needed.

children.description: Clips to parent to the new group, by id or name. Each keeps its own track.

name: ui_timeline_add_marker
description: Drop a marker at an absolute time on the specified timeline sequence, to flag a moment — a beat, a scene boundary, a note for the user. Markers do not render; they are annotations on the ruler.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

timeMs.description: Absolute position on the timeline in ms. Must be >= 0.

label.description: Short label shown on the ruler.

color.description: CSS colour for the marker dot.

note.description: Longer note attached to the marker.

durationMs.description: Length of a range marker in ms. Absent or 0 is a point marker.

name: ui_timeline_add_media_clip
description: Place an existing asset — a video, image, or audio file already in the library — on the specified timeline sequence. `asset` is an asset id or `asset://<id>.<ext>` URI (list_assets returns both). Without a track the clip lands on a track matching its media kind, creating one when needed; without `startMs` it is appended after that track's existing content, so calling this once per asset lays them end to end. Duration comes from the asset unless `durationMs` overrides it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_add_midi_clip
description: Place a midi clip — a phrase played by the track's synth — on a midi track. The notes ride inside the clip in ticks from its content start (960 ticks = one quarter note, read against the document tempo), so trimming the clip hides notes rather than deleting them. `duration_ms` is the window: a note running past its end is gated there. Set the voice with ui_timeline_set_track_instrument and the tempo with ui_timeline_set_tempo.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

track.description: Midi track for the clip, by id or name. Must be a track of type `midi`.

start_ms.description: Where the clip starts on the timeline, in ms.

duration_ms.description: The clip's window length in ms. Notes past the window end are gated at it, not deleted.

id.description: Keep an existing note's id. Omit and one is assigned.

pitch.description: MIDI note number, 0..127. 60 is middle C.

velocity.description: How hard the note is struck, 1..127. Default 100.

start_tick.description: Where the note starts, in ticks from the clip's content start. 960 ticks = one quarter note.

duration_tick.description: How long the note is held, in ticks. 960 = one quarter note.

notes.description: The notes, in ticks from the clip's content start. At most 4096 per clip.

name: ui_timeline_add_model3d_clip
description: Place a glTF model on a picture track of the specified timeline sequence. `assetId` is the .glb/.gltf asset's id (list_assets prints them) — the model is the clip's asset the way an image is an image clip's. Without a track the clip lands on the first overlay track, creating one when there is none; without `startMs` it is appended after that track's content. It lasts 4000ms by default. `style` is the look — camera (orbit azimuth/elevation/fov/zoom, or a glTF camera by name), which animation plays, lighting and background — and every field it leaves out takes the default: a 45°/25° orbit, studio lighting, and a transparent background so the model composites over the picture beneath it. The model's own animation follows the clip's source time, so trimming and speed apply to it like video. For a turntable, animate_clip with the `orbit` preset drives the camera.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

assetId.description: Asset id of the .glb/.gltf model (from list_assets).

mode.description: "orbit" (default) frames the model's bounding sphere with the terms below; "scene" uses a camera the glTF declares and ignores them; "free" places the camera by position, target, rollDeg and fovDeg, with no fit to the model, and ignores azimuthDeg, elevationDeg, zoom and targetOffset.

azimuthDeg.description: Rotation around the model, degrees. 0 is front.

elevationDeg.description: Height of the camera, degrees. 0 is level, 90 is overhead.

fovDeg.description: Vertical field of view, degrees. Lower is a longer lens. On a 24 mm tall sensor a 50 mm lens is about 27 and a 24 mm lens about 53.

zoom.description: Distance multiplier on the auto-framed fit: above 1 moves closer.

targetOffset.description: [x, y, z] offset of the look-at point from the bounding-sphere centre, in the model's own units. Use it to frame a detail off-centre.

sceneCameraName.description: mode "scene" only: the glTF camera to shoot through. The first one when absent.

position.description: mode "free" only: [x, y, z] of the camera eye in the model's own units, Y up. [0, 1.6, 5] when absent.

target.description: mode "free" only: [x, y, z] of the point the camera looks at. [0, 1, 0] when absent.

rollDeg.description: mode "free" only: roll around the view axis, degrees. Positive turns the horizon clockwise in the picture.

focalLengthMm.description: The lens as a focal length in mm on a 24 mm tall sensor, in place of fovDeg: 24 is wide, 35 a moderate wide, 50 normal, 85 a portrait lens. Stored as fovDeg. Send one of the two, not both.

clipName.description: Name of the glTF animation to play. Every animation the model declares plays when this is absent.

loop.description: Wrap at the animation's end (default), or hold its last frame.

speed.description: Playback multiplier on top of the clip's own speed and time remap. The animation follows the clip's source time, so a trim hides frames rather than dropping them.

lighting.description: "studio" (default), "soft" or "flat". The same three presets nodetool.model3d.RenderToImage lights with.

lightIntensity.description: Multiplier on the lighting preset. Default 1.

background.description: {transparent: true} (default — the model composites over the layers under it) or {transparent: false, color: "#101418"}.

name: ui_timeline_add_reframe_keyframe
description: Add or replace a manual Smart Reframe correction on one clip. `source_ms` is absolute time on the clip's source clock, x and y are normalized source-frame coordinates, and optional zoom is 1 or greater. Corrections interpolate around the automatic path and do not overwrite its analysis.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_add_shape_clip
description: Add a rectangle, ellipse, line, polygon, star or path on an overlay track of the specified timeline sequence. The geometry goes in `shape` (or `shapeStyle`, the name `set_clip_params` uses): {kind: "rect"|"ellipse"|"line"|"polygon"|"star"|"path", x, y, width, height, fill, fillStyle, stroke, strokeWidthPx, ...}, with x/y/width/height as 0..1 fractions of the frame; every one of those keys is also read from the top level. With no geometry at all the shape is a full-frame rect. A shape with no colour at all gets a white fill (a line, a white stroke); a shape you fill gets no stroke unless you ask for one. A solid `fill` is opaque unless its colour carries alpha, so a scrim over picture needs 8-digit hex (#05070CCC) or rgba(); for a gradient scrim use fillStyle: {type: "linear", angle, stops: [{offset, color}]} with a transparent stop (#05070C00) at one end. A key this tool does not know is refused by name rather than ignored. `opacity` (0..1) sets the clip's own opacity, which is the other way to author a scrim. `fill` also accepts the gradient object directly. Shapes are rasterized for preview/export and take the standard motion presets.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

fill.description: Solid colour string or linear/radial gradient object. Alpha belongs in the colour or gradient stop colours.

stroke.description: Outline colour. Omit it and the shape is drawn with no outline; `strokeWidthPx` defaults to 8 once a stroke colour is set.

strokeWidthPx.description: Outline width in sequence pixels. Default 8.

x.description: Left edge (or the line's first point), 0..1 of frame width.

y.description: Top edge (or the line's first point), 0..1 of frame height.

x2.description: kind "line" only: the second point, 0..1 of frame width.

y2.description: kind "line" only: the second point, 0..1 of frame height.

d.description: kind "path" only: SVG path data in the same 0..1 space.

innerRadius.description: kind "star" only: inner radius as a fraction of the outer.

cornerRadius.description: Corner rounding, in the same normalized units.

fillStyle.description: Gradient or solid fill, wins over `fill` when set. A soft scrim is {type: "linear", angle: 90, stops: [{offset: 0, color: "#05070C00"}, {offset: 1, color: "#05070CDD"}]} — the alpha lives in the stop colours.

dash.description: Dash pattern in normalized units, as ctx.setLineDash takes it.

trimStart.description: Stroke only the sub-range [trimStart, trimEnd] of the path, 0..1.

trimEnd.description: Stroke only the sub-range [trimStart, trimEnd] of the path, 0..1.

y2.description: kind "line" only: the second point, 0..1 of frame height.

name: ui_timeline_add_text_clip
description: Add authored text to the specified timeline sequence. It goes on an overlay track, creating one when needed, lasts 3000ms by default, and accepts the same motion presets as media clips. The look goes in `style` — {fontSizePx, fontFamily, fontWeight, color, align, maxWidthFrac, stroke, shadow, background, fill, ...} — and every one of those keys is also read from the top level. `fontSizePx` is in sequence pixels, so 120 in a 1080p frame is 120px tall. `opacity` (0..1) sets the clip's own opacity. A key neither this tool nor the style bag knows is refused by name rather than ignored.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

fontSizePx.description: Font size in sequence pixels, not CSS pixels.

fontWeight.description: Numeric weight (400 regular, 600 semibold, 800 extrabold). The CSS keywords ("bold", "semibold", …) are accepted and stored as their number.

maxWidthFrac.description: Wrap width as a fraction of frame width.

letterSpacingPx.description: Extra advance between glyphs, in sequence px. Default 0.

lineHeight.description: Line advance as a multiple of the font size. Default 1.2.

verticalAlign.description: "top", "middle" (default) or "bottom". Not "center" — that is the horizontal `align` spelling.

strikethrough.description: Draw a line through the text in its fill colour, as on a superseded price.

stroke.description: Outline drawn under the fill: {color, widthPx}.

shadow.description: Drop shadow behind the glyphs: {color, blurPx, offsetX?, offsetY?}. The blur field is `blurPx`, not `blur`; the offsets default to 0.

background.description: Scrim drawn behind the wrapped block: {color, paddingPx, radiusPx?}. The rounding field is `radiusPx`, not `cornerRadius`. An 8-digit hex or rgba() colour keeps the picture visible through it.

fill.description: Gradient or solid fill, {type: "solid"|"linear"|"radial", ...}. Wins over `color` when set.

fontSizePx.description: Font size in sequence pixels, not CSS pixels.

fontWeight.description: Numeric weight (400 regular, 600 semibold, 800 extrabold). The CSS keywords ("bold", "semibold", …) are accepted and stored as their number.

maxWidthFrac.description: Wrap width as a fraction of frame width.

letterSpacingPx.description: Extra advance between glyphs, in sequence px. Default 0.

lineHeight.description: Line advance as a multiple of the font size. Default 1.2.

verticalAlign.description: "top", "middle" (default) or "bottom". Not "center" — that is the horizontal `align` spelling.

strikethrough.description: Draw a line through the text in its fill colour, as on a superseded price.

stroke.description: Outline drawn under the fill: {color, widthPx}.

shadow.description: Drop shadow behind the glyphs: {color, blurPx, offsetX?, offsetY?}. The blur field is `blurPx`, not `blur`; the offsets default to 0.

background.description: Scrim drawn behind the wrapped block: {color, paddingPx, radiusPx?}. The rounding field is `radiusPx`, not `cornerRadius`. An 8-digit hex or rgba() colour keeps the picture visible through it.

fill.description: Gradient or solid fill, {type: "solid"|"linear"|"radial", ...}. Wins over `color` when set.

name: ui_timeline_add_track
description: Add a new track to the specified timeline sequence. `type` is one of video, audio, overlay, subtitle, midi. Optionally provide a name. The new track goes to the BOTTOM of the stack, and track order is z-order: index 0 draws on top, so a track added later renders *under* the ones already there. Add overlays and titles after the picture track they sit on, or reorder afterwards with move_track.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_animate_clip
description: Attach motion-design animations to a clip with named presets or custom curves. Roles: `in`, `out`, `emphasis`, `loop`. For `typewriter` on text, `durationMs` is the time to reveal the entire line; without it, characters type 65ms apart. `stagger: {offsetMs: 55}` customizes the speed and defaults to character units. Optional `caret: {color, widthPx, blinkPeriodMs}` follows the visible text. Other text animations can stagger by word, character, or wrapped line. Use `preset: "custom"` with `curves` to animate properties including rotationX and rotationY; set perspective on the clip transform. `mode` "replace" (default) swaps animations; "add" appends. Call ui_timeline_list_animation_presets for the full contract.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

preset.description: Preset id, e.g. fade, slide, wipe, pop, kenBurns, float — or "custom" with `curves` or `code`.

curves.description: Keyframes for `preset: "custom"`. Exactly one of `curves` and `code`.

property.description: One of: offsetX, offsetY, scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, rotationX, rotationY, opacity, wipeProgress, blur, brightness, saturation, contrast, hue, temperature, tint, positionX, positionY, anchorX, anchorY, trimStart, trimEnd, cameraAzimuth, cameraElevation, cameraZoom, cameraFov, cameraPosX, cameraPosY, cameraPosZ, cameraTargetX, cameraTargetY, cameraTargetZ, cameraRoll.

code.description: JS body for `preset: "custom"`, baked into curves once, host-side. It returns `{curves}` or `{samples}` and reads its clip context off `inputs`. Exactly one of `curves` and `code`.

mask.description: Required when a curve drives wipeProgress, ignored otherwise.

custom.description: Same as `curves`/`code`/`mask` one level down: {preset: "custom", custom: {curves: [...]}} is accepted and lifted.

curves.description: Keyframes for `preset: "custom"`. Exactly one of `curves` and `code`.

property.description: One of: offsetX, offsetY, scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, rotationX, rotationY, opacity, wipeProgress, blur, brightness, saturation, contrast, hue, temperature, tint, positionX, positionY, anchorX, anchorY, trimStart, trimEnd, cameraAzimuth, cameraElevation, cameraZoom, cameraFov, cameraPosX, cameraPosY, cameraPosZ, cameraTargetX, cameraTargetY, cameraTargetZ, cameraRoll.

code.description: JS body for `preset: "custom"`, baked into curves once, host-side. It returns `{curves}` or `{samples}` and reads its clip context off `inputs`. Exactly one of `curves` and `code`.

mask.description: Required when a curve drives wipeProgress, ignored otherwise.

stagger.description: Per-unit stagger — text clips only. The animation runs once per word, grapheme cluster or wrapped line, each unit offset from the previous. Unit defaults to character.

offsetMs.description: Delay between successive units in ms.

caret.description: Optional typewriter caret, drawn after the last visible character.

name: ui_timeline_apply_model3d_camera_move
description: Key a camera move onto a 3D clip whose camera is in free mode. The move starts from the camera as it stands at `startMs` and runs for `durationMs`, both in milliseconds from the clip's start, so moves chain: a push in over 0 to 2000 and an orbit from 2000 on. Keyframes the move's channels already had inside that span are replaced. `amount` is in the move's own unit. Degrees: pan (default 30, positive turns right), tilt (15, up), orbit (45, the eye circles to the camera's right around the target), dutch (15, the horizon turns clockwise). A fraction of the eye-to-target distance at the start: pushIn (0.3, negative pulls out), truck (0.25, right), crane (0.25, the eye rises and keeps its target), pedestal (0.25, eye and target rise together), dollyZoom (0.4, the eye moves in while the lens widens). A multiplier on the focal length: zoom (1.5, above 1 zooms in). A negative amount reverses a move. The result carries the camera at the start and the end of the move. Put the clip in free mode first with set_model3d_style {patch: {camera: {mode: "free", position, target}}}.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

amount.description: How far, in the move's unit: degrees, a fraction of the eye-to-target distance, or a focal-length multiplier. The move's default when absent.

startMs.description: When the move starts, in milliseconds from the clip's start. Default 0.

durationMs.description: How long the move runs, in milliseconds. Default the rest of the clip.

easing.description: Easing over the whole move, such as "easeInOut". Linear when absent.

name: ui_timeline_apply_take
description: Apply one completed candidate take to an existing clip. This is the explicit acceptance step for ui_timeline_generatively_edit_clip and is one undoable editorial operation. `clip_id` and `take_id` must identify a successful take on the same clip.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_bake_model3d_clip
description: Render a 3D clip through Blender and store the result on it, so the clip plays that video instead of the live proxy. The bake is the clip as it stands — its trim, speed, time remap, animation choice and camera move all applied — at the sequence's fps and resolution, and it is played from the clip's own first frame. Any later edit that changes the picture (the style, the model, the trim, the duration, the speed, the remap, a camera animation, or the sequence settings) makes it stale and the live 3D layer draws again until it is baked afresh; validate_timeline reports that as `bake_stale`. A clip with a transparent background is refused: an alpha bake needs a WebM VP9 encode this build does not have.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_clear_animations
description: Remove motion-design animations from a clip. Pass `role` to clear only that role (in/out/emphasis/loop); omit it to clear all.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_clear_reframe
description: Remove Smart Reframe state from one clip while leaving its source asset, timing, static crop, transform and every other editorial property unchanged.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_close_gap
description: Close the empty stretch on a track at a time: everything on an unlocked track that starts at or after the gap's end moves left by the gap's length. `atMs` is any time inside the gap. Nothing changes when a clip covers `atMs`, when no clip follows the gap, or when closing it would separate a link group; the result says which.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

atMs.description: A time inside the gap, in ms.

name: ui_timeline_cut_transcript
description: Cut words out of the transcript, which cuts the media under them: the span is ripple-deleted across every track, so later clips move left. Give `startMs` and `endMs` (absolute sequence times; a word's absolute time is its clip's `startMs` plus the word's own `startMs`), or `fillers: true` to remove every filler word (um, uh, and the like) in one pass. A span over a word of a locked clip is refused.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_delete_clip
description: Remove a clip from the specified timeline sequence.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_delete_marker
description: Remove a marker from the specified timeline sequence by id or by its label (case-insensitive). Call ui_timeline_get_state to see the markers it carries.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Marker id or label (case-insensitive).

name: ui_timeline_delete_track
description: Remove one track from the specified timeline sequence, named in `target` (a track id or name). Every track below it moves up one index, which is z-order, so the stack closes over the gap. A track that still holds clips is refused unless you pass `deleteClips: true` — then the clips go with it. An empty track draws nothing, so delete one to tidy the stack, not to fix a render.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Track id or track name (case-insensitive).

deleteClips.description: Required to delete a track that still holds clips; they go with it.

name: ui_timeline_duplicate_clip
description: Duplicate a clip. The copy is placed immediately after the source (add `gapMs` for a gap) and keeps its generation binding so you can tweak the copy for a variation.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_generate_clip
description: Generate a new media clip from a text prompt and place it on the specified timeline sequence. `kind` is text-to-video, text-to-image, or text-to-audio (TTS). Provide `provider` and `model` (discover valid ones with the model-search tool); when omitted the last-used model for that media kind is reused. `voice` is required for text-to-audio. Without a track the clip lands on a sensible track for its media kind; without `startMs` it is appended after the track's existing content. Generation starts immediately unless `autoGenerate` is false. For text-to-video, `aspectRatio` (e.g. "16:9") and `resolution` (e.g. "720p") and `durationMs` are honoured by video models.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_generate_from_beats
description: Turn the reviewed plan into a cut: one text-to-video clip per beat on the video track, one text-to-audio clip per beat that carries a voiceover, one music clip when any beat asks for music, and each beat's transition applied to its clip. In the editor every clip's generation is enqueued and the clips appear as placeholders that fill in; headlessly the clips are authored and nothing renders. Sets the stage to done.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

model.description: Video model id for the beat clips.

voice.description: Voice id for the voiceover clips. Omit for no voiceover.

music.description: Add the music clip. Default: whether any beat asks for it.

name: ui_timeline_generatively_edit_clip
description: Start a nondestructive video edit for an existing clip. `clip_id` is explicit and `instruction` describes the change. The request uses the clip's submitted playable source window and returns a candidate take when generation completes; it never applies the candidate. Provide `provider` and `model` together for a known video-to-video model, or omit both in the browser to use the last-used video-edit model. Headless callers must provide the pair. The clip's generic model is never used as an edit model.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_get_clip_frames
description: Inspect visual frames from ONE rendered clip. `target` names the clip. Video samples source pixels, while text, shape and 3D clips use the shared renderer. To inspect the layered timeline, call preview_timeline_frame. Optional timesMs accepts absolute timeline times or clip-relative times outside the timeline span. Returns image data URLs with timeline/source timestamps.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_get_state
description: Read the specified timeline sequence: resolution + fps + duration, the playhead position, the current selection, every track, and every clip with its timing, media type, generation binding (prompt/provider/model/status) and render params. Call this first to discover what's on the timeline and to get the ids/names other timeline tools need.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_list_animation_presets
description: List the motion-design animation presets: id, allowed roles, params (with defaults and ranges), default duration/easing, and a one-line description. Also returns the `custom` preset's contract and every animatable property with its fold, identity and range, for keyframed motion no preset covers. Use this to discover the exact preset names and params for ui_timeline_animate_clip.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_list_instruments
description: List the instruments a midi track can hold (WT-1, BL-1, DR-1, sampler, VST), each with its preset ids and names. Pick an instrument, then one of its presets, and pass that id to ui_timeline_set_track_instrument as `{"preset": id}`.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_move_clip
description: Move a clip to a new absolute start time and/or onto a different track. `startMs` is the new start on the timeline (ms, clamped to >= 0); `trackId` reassigns the track. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_move_track
description: Reorder one track in the stack, which is what decides z-order: index 0 draws on top of every track below it. Name the track in `target` and its destination with exactly one of `toIndex` (0 is the top), `before` (a track it should draw in front of) or `after`. Clips do not move — only which track covers which. Use it when a picture track added last is hiding the overlays beneath it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Track id or track name (case-insensitive).

toIndex.description: Destination index; 0 is the top of the stack.

name: ui_timeline_plan_beats
description: Write the beat plan a video is cut from — one row per shot, each with its prompt, its length in milliseconds, an optional transition into it, and an optional voiceover line. Pass `beats` to set the plan yourself; omit it in the editor and the Director drafts one from the sequence's brief and format. This is the cheap step: it creates no clip and starts no job, and the plan stays editable until generate_from_beats runs. Sets the stage to review.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

beats.description: The plan, in cut order. Replaces any existing beats.

replan.description: Re-run the Director over the beats already stored, using them as context, rather than starting fresh.

name: ui_timeline_quantize_notes
description: Snap a midi clip's note onsets to a grid. The grid is a note value — 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, or the triplets 1/8T and 1/16T — read in ticks at PPQ 960, so 1/4 is 960 ticks and 1/16 is 240. `strength` below 1 moves each note part of the way and keeps the part's feel; `target` "start_and_length" also rounds how long each note is held.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

clip.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

division.description: The grid, as a note value: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, or the triplets 1/8T and 1/16T. Ticks are PPQ 960, so 1/4 is 960 ticks, 1/16 is 240 and 1/8T is 320.

strength.description: How far toward the grid each note travels. 1 snaps exactly, 0.5 halves the distance, 0 changes nothing. Default 1.

target.description: "start" moves onsets only; "start_and_length" also rounds each held length to whole grid steps, never below one. Default "start".

name: ui_timeline_remove_beat
description: Drop one beat from the plan, by its id or its 1-based position. The beats around it keep their order and their ids, and their positions close up. This edits text only: a clip already generated from the beat stays on the timeline, so delete that separately if you no longer want it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

beat.description: A beat id, or its 1-based position as a string ("3").

name: ui_timeline_render_model3d_reference
description: Render a 3D clip's span as a grey reference video and store it on the clip as model3dStyle.reference. A video model follows this video when a storyboard shot linked to the clip is generated. The clip is not changed on the timeline and never plays the reference. `pass` picks what each frame draws: "clay" (default) is one grey matte material under a fixed light, "depth" is distance from the camera with near white and far black, "normal" is view-space surface normals as RGB. Every pass is drawn on an opaque neutral background and ignores the clip's lighting and background. The render covers the clip as it stands, with its trim, speed, animation choice and camera keys applied, at the sequence's fps. The longest side is at most 1280 px. A later change to the model, the camera, the span or the sequence settings makes the reference stale. A call on a clip whose stored reference is current renders nothing and returns it. The result carries `reference` {assetId, dependencyHash, pass} and `cameraMove`, a one-sentence description of the camera move.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

pass.description: What each frame draws. "clay" when absent.

name: ui_timeline_retarget_format
description: Create a new sequence adapted to another aspect ratio without changing the source sequence. Center uses a static centered crop. Smart derives source-time framing paths from current subject tracks or authored framing and refuses clips with neither signal. Track follows the per-clip MediaTrack ids in `track_ids`. Timing, audio, cuts, effects, takes, captions, markers and tracking are preserved.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

aspect_ratio.description: Target display aspect, for example "9:16", "1:1" or "4:5".

safe_margin.description: Safe margin around the followed subject, as a 0..0.5 fraction.

track_ids.description: Optional map of clip id to preferred MediaTrack id.

name: ui_timeline_ripple_delete
description: Delete clips and close the hole they leave: every clip on an unlocked track that starts after a removed span moves left by its length, on every track, so voiceover and captions stay in sync with the picture. Use ui_timeline_delete_clip to leave the gap. Link groups move whole; when closing a span would separate one, the clips are still removed and that span stays open, and the result says so.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

items.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_scale_velocity
description: Scale how hard every note in a midi clip is struck. Velocities are clamped to 1..127, so a large factor flattens the part's dynamics rather than making it louder — set the track's `gainDb` for level.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

clip.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

factor.description: Multiplier on every velocity. 1.2 plays the phrase harder, 0.8 softer.

name: ui_timeline_seek
description: Move the playhead to an absolute time (ms) in the specified timeline sequence. Useful before splitting at the playhead.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_select_clip
description: Select a clip in the specified timeline sequence (driving the inspector). Pass null/empty to clear the selection.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

anyOf.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_set_clip_binding
description: Edit a generated clip's generation binding — its `prompt`, `negativePrompt`, `provider`/`model`, TTS `voice`, dimensions, `aspectRatio`/`resolution`, `strength`, or `numInferenceSteps`. Set `regenerate` true to immediately re-run generation with the new settings. Only applies to generated clips.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_set_clip_params
description: Change a clip's render/audio params: `name`, `opacity` (0..1), `speedMultiplier` (0.1..8), `volumeDb`, `fadeInMs`, `fadeOutMs` (fade the audio and, on a visual clip, the picture), `fadeInShape`/`fadeOutShape` (`linear`, `sCurve`, `plus3dB`, `minus3dB`), `audioEffects` (the clip's whole real-time audio chain, in order: `gain`, `eq3`, `filter`, `compressor`, `echo`, `reverb`, `distortion`; `[]` removes them), `blendMode`, `borderRadius`, `hidden`, `muted`, `locked`, a text clip's `textStyle`, a shape clip's `shapeStyle`, or a caption clip's `captionStyle`. `fontSizePx` is shorthand for `textStyle.fontSizePx`. Timing is accepted too and applied as trim_clip/move_clip would: `durationMs`, `inPointMs`, `outPointMs`, `startMs`, `trackId`. A key this tool does not know is refused by name rather than ignored. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

fontSizePx.description: Font size in sequence pixels, not CSS pixels.

fontWeight.description: Numeric weight (400 regular, 600 semibold, 800 extrabold). The CSS keywords ("bold", "semibold", …) are accepted and stored as their number.

maxWidthFrac.description: Wrap width as a fraction of frame width.

letterSpacingPx.description: Extra advance between glyphs, in sequence px. Default 0.

lineHeight.description: Line advance as a multiple of the font size. Default 1.2.

verticalAlign.description: "top", "middle" (default) or "bottom". Not "center" — that is the horizontal `align` spelling.

strikethrough.description: Draw a line through the text in its fill colour, as on a superseded price.

stroke.description: Outline drawn under the fill: {color, widthPx}.

shadow.description: Drop shadow behind the glyphs: {color, blurPx, offsetX?, offsetY?}. The blur field is `blurPx`, not `blur`; the offsets default to 0.

background.description: Scrim drawn behind the wrapped block: {color, paddingPx, radiusPx?}. The rounding field is `radiusPx`, not `cornerRadius`. An 8-digit hex or rgba() colour keeps the picture visible through it.

fill.description: Gradient or solid fill, {type: "solid"|"linear"|"radial", ...}. Wins over `color` when set.
Solid colour string or linear/radial gradient object. Alpha belongs in the colour or gradient stop colours.

stroke.description: Outline colour. Omit it and the shape is drawn with no outline; `strokeWidthPx` defaults to 8 once a stroke colour is set.

strokeWidthPx.description: Outline width in sequence pixels. Default 8.

x.description: Left edge (or the line's first point), 0..1 of frame width.

y.description: Top edge (or the line's first point), 0..1 of frame height.

x2.description: kind "line" only: the second point, 0..1 of frame width.

y2.description: kind "line" only: the second point, 0..1 of frame height.

d.description: kind "path" only: SVG path data in the same 0..1 space.

innerRadius.description: kind "star" only: inner radius as a fraction of the outer.

cornerRadius.description: Corner rounding, in the same normalized units.

fillStyle.description: Gradient or solid fill, wins over `fill` when set. A soft scrim is {type: "linear", angle: 90, stops: [{offset: 0, color: "#05070C00"}, {offset: 1, color: "#05070CDD"}]} — the alpha lives in the stop colours.

dash.description: Dash pattern in normalized units, as ctx.setLineDash takes it.

trimStart.description: Stroke only the sub-range [trimStart, trimEnd] of the path, 0..1.

trimEnd.description: Stroke only the sub-range [trimStart, trimEnd] of the path, 0..1.

fontSizeFrac.description: Font size as a fraction of frame height. Default 0.05.

color.description: Colour of the words not being spoken.

activeColor.description: Colour of the word being spoken. Default #FFD60A.

outline.description: Outline under the glyphs. widthPx 0 draws none.

bottomMarginFrac.description: Gap from the frame bottom, as a fraction of height. Default 0.12.

name: ui_timeline_set_effects
description: Replace a clip's effect chain, or clear it with `effects: []`. The list runs in order on the clip's own pixels, before it is placed on the frame. Types: color (brightness/contrast/saturation/hue/temperature/tint/shadows/highlights), blur, glow, dropShadow, vignette, sharpen, chromaKey, curves (control points, 0..1 on both axes), levels (in/out black and white plus gamma), liftGammaGain (a three-way grade, one number per channel). This replaces the whole chain — send every effect the clip should keep.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

masks.description: Grade effects (color, exposure, liftGammaGain, curves, hueSatCurves, secondaryColor, vignette, sharpen, blur): masks that limit where the effect lands. Each mask is a closed path of clip-normalized vertices {x,y,inX?,inY?,outX?,outY?} (tangents relative to the vertex; an ellipse is 4 smooth vertices), shape 'ellipse'|'polygon'|'bezier', feather and expansion as fractions of the clip's shorter side, opacity 0..1, inverted, mode add|subtract|intersect.

temporalStrength.description: denoise: motion-compensated neighboring-frame strength, 0..1, default 0. Video only.

strength.description: deband/deflicker/stabilize: effect strength, 0..1. Deband defaults to 0, the analysis effects to 1.

windowMs.description: deflicker/stabilize: symmetric analysis window in milliseconds, default 500.

maxCorrection.description: deflicker: maximum correction in exposure stops, default 1.

maxZoom.description: stabilize: maximum fixed zoom, default 1.1. Limits correction to avoid exposed borders.

analysis.description: Saved deflicker or stabilization source analysis. Neutral until matching analysis is available.

range.description: deband: neighborhood range in source pixels, default 16.

threshold.description: deband: maximum encoded RGB difference for smoothing, default 0.02.

dither.description: deband: fixed monochrome dither, up to one output byte level peak to peak, default 0.5.

hueCurve.description: secondaryColor: periodic hue-input curve, neutral output 0.5.

saturationCurve.description: secondaryColor: periodic hue-input curve, neutral output 0.5.

blacks.description: exposure: shadow-weighted lift (positive) or crush (negative), -1..1, default 0.

hueVsSat.description: hueSatCurves: periodic hue-input saturation multiplier curve, neutral output 0.5 (0x..2x).

hueVsHue.description: hueSatCurves: periodic hue-input hue shift curve, neutral output 0.5 (-180..180 degrees).

hueVsLuma.description: hueSatCurves: periodic hue-input lightness offset curve, neutral output 0.5 (-0.5..0.5, weighted by saturation).

lumaVsSat.description: hueSatCurves: lightness-input saturation multiplier curve, neutral output 0.5 (0x..2x).

satVsSat.description: hueSatCurves: saturation-input saturation multiplier curve, neutral output 0.5 (0x..2x).

radius.description: blur, glow and sharpen: radius in source pixels. vignette: normalized outer radius, 0.1..1.5.

roundness.description: vignette: 0 is a frame-shaped oval, 1 a circle, -1 a rounded rectangle.

cellSize.description: pixelate: square cell width in source pixels.

angle.description: directionalBlur and visual effects: angle in degrees.

time.description: stylize or generator time in seconds.

seed.description: stylize, generator or grain deterministic seed.

cube.description: lut: full contents of a 3D .cube file.

offsetX.description: dropShadow: offset in the clip's own pixels, positive is right.

offsetY.description: dropShadow: offset in the clip's own pixels, positive is down.

color.description: dropShadow shadow colour, chromaKey key colour, e.g. #00ff00.

size.description: grain: grain size in rendered pixels, 1 is fine grain.

colorAmount.description: grain: 0 is monochrome grain, 1 full colour noise.

animate.description: grain: roll the pattern once per sequence frame instead of holding one.

softness.description: vignette falloff, chromaKey edge or grain softening, 0..1. Grain defaults to 0.25.

effects.description: The chain, in order. An empty list clears it.

name: ui_timeline_set_markers_from_beats
description: Lay a marker on every beat of a grid, so the cut has something to work against. The grid is either `onsets_ms` — detect_audio_events reports `onsets.times` in SECONDS, so multiply by 1000 — or `bpm` with `count` and an optional `offset_ms` for where beat one sits. Markers already on the sequence are kept, and a beat that already carries one is skipped, so re-running the same grid changes nothing.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

onsets_ms.description: Absolute beat times in ms. Exactly one of this and `bpm`.

offset_ms.description: Where beat one sits, in ms. Default 0.

label.description: Label stem; each marker is numbered from 1 ("Beat 1", "Beat 2", …). Default "Beat".

name: ui_timeline_set_mask
description: Mask a clip to a rectangle, an ellipse or an SVG path, or clear it with `mask: null`. Coordinates are 0..1 in the clip's own space, so the mask turns and scales with the clip. `featherPx` softens the edge; `invert` keeps what the shape excludes instead.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

x.description: Left edge, 0..1 of the layer's width. Default 0.

y.description: Top edge, 0..1 of the layer's height. Default 0.

width.description: Width, 0..1 of the layer's width. Default 1.

height.description: Height, 0..1 of the layer's height. Default 1.

radiusPx.description: rect only: corner radius in source pixels.

d.description: kind "path" only: SVG path data in the same 0..1 space. M, L, C, Q and Z, absolute or relative.

featherPx.description: Soft edge width in the layer's own pixels. 0 is a hard edge.

invert.description: Keep what the mask excludes instead of what it covers.

name: ui_timeline_set_matte
description: Drive a clip's transparency from another clip — a track matte — or clear it with `matte: null`. The source clip stops drawing itself: its alpha (`mode: "alpha"`) or its brightness (`mode: "luma"`) becomes the target's transparency, so a white shape over black shows the target only where the shape is. Both clips are placed by their own transforms, so where the source sits on the frame is where the target shows through.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

source.description: The clip whose pixels drive the alpha, by id or name.

mode.description: alpha reads the source's transparency; luma reads its brightness.

name: ui_timeline_set_model3d_style
description: Change a 3D clip's camera, animation choice, lighting or background. The patch merges one level down, so {camera: {azimuthDeg: 90}} turns the model and keeps the elevation, lens and framing it was framed at. `background` replaces whole: {transparent: true} or {transparent: false, color}. Use animate_clip with the `orbit` preset for a camera move over time rather than a fixed pose. A blockout camera is {camera: {mode: "free", position, target, focalLengthMm, rollDeg}}, in the model's own units with Y up. `keyAtMs` keys that free camera instead of re-posing the clip: the position, target, rollDeg and lens in the patch (or, for the ones it leaves out, the camera as it stands at that time) become keyframes at `keyAtMs` milliseconds from the clip's start, and the camera eases between keys. Key 0 first, then the later poses. For a named move such as a push in or an orbit use apply_model3d_camera_move.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

mode.description: "orbit" (default) frames the model's bounding sphere with the terms below; "scene" uses a camera the glTF declares and ignores them; "free" places the camera by position, target, rollDeg and fovDeg, with no fit to the model, and ignores azimuthDeg, elevationDeg, zoom and targetOffset.

azimuthDeg.description: Rotation around the model, degrees. 0 is front.

elevationDeg.description: Height of the camera, degrees. 0 is level, 90 is overhead.

fovDeg.description: Vertical field of view, degrees. Lower is a longer lens. On a 24 mm tall sensor a 50 mm lens is about 27 and a 24 mm lens about 53.

zoom.description: Distance multiplier on the auto-framed fit: above 1 moves closer.

targetOffset.description: [x, y, z] offset of the look-at point from the bounding-sphere centre, in the model's own units. Use it to frame a detail off-centre.

sceneCameraName.description: mode "scene" only: the glTF camera to shoot through. The first one when absent.

position.description: mode "free" only: [x, y, z] of the camera eye in the model's own units, Y up. [0, 1.6, 5] when absent.

target.description: mode "free" only: [x, y, z] of the point the camera looks at. [0, 1, 0] when absent.

rollDeg.description: mode "free" only: roll around the view axis, degrees. Positive turns the horizon clockwise in the picture.

focalLengthMm.description: The lens as a focal length in mm on a 24 mm tall sensor, in place of fovDeg: 24 is wide, 35 a moderate wide, 50 normal, 85 a portrait lens. Stored as fovDeg. Send one of the two, not both.

clipName.description: Name of the glTF animation to play. Every animation the model declares plays when this is absent.

loop.description: Wrap at the animation's end (default), or hold its last frame.

speed.description: Playback multiplier on top of the clip's own speed and time remap. The animation follows the clip's source time, so a trim hides frames rather than dropping them.

lighting.description: "studio" (default), "soft" or "flat". The same three presets nodetool.model3d.RenderToImage lights with.

lightIntensity.description: Multiplier on the lighting preset. Default 1.

background.description: {transparent: true} (default — the model composites over the layers under it) or {transparent: false, color: "#101418"}.

keyAtMs.description: Key the free camera at this time, in milliseconds from the clip's start, instead of changing its resting pose. Needs camera mode "free".

keyEasing.description: With keyAtMs: the easing of the move arriving at this key, such as "easeInOut". Linear when absent.

name: ui_timeline_set_notes
description: Replace a midi clip's notes. This is the whole list, not a merge — send every note the clip should keep, each with `pitch`, `start_tick` and `duration_tick` (960 ticks = one quarter note, counted from the clip's content start). Pass a note's `id` to keep the one it already has.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

clip.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

id.description: Keep an existing note's id. Omit and one is assigned.

pitch.description: MIDI note number, 0..127. 60 is middle C.

velocity.description: How hard the note is struck, 1..127. Default 100.

start_tick.description: Where the note starts, in ticks from the clip's content start. 960 ticks = one quarter note.

duration_tick.description: How long the note is held, in ticks. 960 = one quarter note.

notes.description: The clip's complete note list; this replaces what is there. Pass a note's `id` to keep it.

name: ui_timeline_set_parent
description: Parent a clip to a group so it inherits the group's transform, opacity and window, or release it with `parentId: null`. The parent must be a clip created with ui_timeline_add_group; a clip cannot parent itself or any group beneath it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

parentId.description: The group clip to inherit from, by id or name. null releases the clip.

name: ui_timeline_set_reframe_subject
description: Set the subject track that drives one clip's source-time Smart Reframe crop. The clip and MediaTrack must belong to the current sequence. This changes editorial framing only and does not alter or regenerate the source asset.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

safe_margin.description: Safe margin around the followed subject, as a 0..0.5 fraction.

name: ui_timeline_set_setup
description: Write the guided video flow's state onto a sequence: the brief it is being built from, the format card it follows, whether the cut is voiced, and the step it sits on. Stages are idea, format, review, look, done — a surface showing the flow resumes at whichever one is stored, and `done` hands the sequence back to the editor. Nothing here generates or places anything.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

stage.description: The step the flow resumes at. Omit to leave it alone.

brief.description: What the video is, in the creator's own words.

voiceover.description: Whether the cut is voiced. Omit and each beat's own line decides; false is a deliberate silence that leaves the lines on the beats, so nothing the creator wrote is thrown away.

name: ui_timeline_set_tempo
description: Set the document's constant tempo. Milliseconds are the timeline's master clock and a note's ticks are read against the tempo, so changing it rescales every midi clip around `offset_ms` — halving the BPM doubles each midi clip's start and length, and the notes keep their place inside it. Clips that are not midi do not move, so a midi part re-tempoed against picture will no longer line up with it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

offset_ms.description: Where beat one sits on the timeline, in ms. Default 0.

name: ui_timeline_set_time_remap
description: Retime a clip from a curve — ramps, freezes, speed changes — or clear it with `timeRemap: null` so it plays at its own rate. Each keyframe says where in the source media (`sourceMs`) the clip sits at position `t`, normalized 0..1 over the clip's own window — so the list must start at 0, end at 1, ascend in `t`, and hold at least two keyframes. A `sourceMs` that descends is reverse playback, a flat pair is a freeze, and a steeper segment plays faster. A remap replaces the clip's rate entirely, and split and trim refuse a remapped clip: clear the curve first.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

sourceMs.description: Milliseconds into the source media shown at this position.

easing.description: Easing for the segment ending here. Default linear.

keyframes.description: At least two keyframes, ascending in `t`, starting at 0 and ending at 1.

timeRemap.description: The curve, or null to clear it and play at the clip's rate.

name: ui_timeline_set_track
description: Change a track's own settings: `name`, `muted`, `solo`, `locked`, `visible`, `volumeDb` (the channel fader, audio and midi tracks only), `pan` (-1 left to 1 right, audio and midi tracks only) or `heightPx` (the row height in the editor). Send only the fields to change. Mute and volume here apply to every clip on the track; use ui_timeline_set_clip_params for one clip. A locked track refuses every other edit, so unlock it in its own call first.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_set_track_instrument
description: Set the synth a midi track plays. Every clip on the track uses it — the track owns the instrument, not the clip — so moving a clip to another midi track changes its sound.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

track.description: Midi track, by id or name.

preset.description: A shipped voice by id. ui_timeline_list_instruments lists the ids under each instrument. sampler starts an empty sample instrument. For recordings pass a full sampler instrument: type sampler, zones [{id, name, assetId (full audio asset id), rootNote, lowNote, highNote, gainDb}], oneShot, attackMs, releaseMs, gainDb. One-shot plays full recordings; gated mode releases on note-off. Recordings must be at most 60 seconds. Soundtrack presets: wt1-cinematic-strings, wt1-chamber-strings, wt1-short-strings, wt1-low-strings, wt1-warm-brass, wt1-air-choir, wt1-dark-swell, wt1-soft-keys, wt1-glass-mallet, wt1-muted-pluck, bl1-cinematic-sub, bl1-score-pulse, bl1-rounded-bass, dr1-cinematic. Also available: saw-lead, square-lead, soft-pad, pluck, bass, bell, wt1-prime-lead, wt1-bloom-pad, wt1-vox-morph, wt1-chime-bell, bl1-acid, bl1-deep, bl1-rubber, dr1-tr-void. Orchestral voices are synthesized. Play low strings around MIDI 36–55, ensembles around 48–79, and basses around 28–48. Drum pads use MIDI 36–51.

instrument.description: The voice this track's clips play, either way round. Named: `{"preset": "wt1-cinematic-strings"}`. See the preset field for available voices. Spelled out, there are four synths. `subtractive` is one oscillator through a lowpass filter and an ADSR envelope: `waveform` saw/square/triangle/sine, `attackMs`/`decayMs`/`releaseMs` in milliseconds, `sustain` 0..1 of the peak, `cutoffHz` the filter frequency in Hz, `resonance` its Q, `gainDb` the output level in dB. The other three are the FableSynth instruments: `wavetable` (WT-1) is two morphing wavetable oscillators plus a sub and noise through one filter swept by `modEnv`; `bass` (BL-1) is a monophonic acid line where a note at or above `accentVelocity` hits harder and a note overlapping the one before it glides over `slideMs`; `drum` (DR-1) is a kit of pads played one per note from `baseNote`, each ringing for its own decay however short the note is.

name: ui_timeline_set_transition
description: Set the transition a clip opens with, or clear it with `transition: null`. A transition is between two clips: it plays over the head of `target` against whatever sits beneath it on the same track, so overlap the two clips by at least `durationMs` for both to be seen. Types: crossfade (dissolve), dipToColor (through a solid), wipe (feathered reveal), push (both clips travel), slide (only the incoming moves), zoom. With no transition set, overlapping clips still auto-dissolve across the overlap.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

durationMs.description: Length of the cut from the clip's start. 0 or less is a hard cut.

direction.description: wipe, push and slide only: the edge the incoming clip arrives from.

softness.description: wipe, gradientWipe or iris: feathered edge width, 0..1.

scale.description: gradientWipe noise frequency or lightLeak field falloff.

blur.description: whip or zoomBlur: blur radius in source pixels.

name: ui_timeline_snap_to_beats
description: Put clip boundaries on a beat grid. The grid is either `onsets_ms` — detect_audio_events reports `onsets.times` in SECONDS, so multiply by 1000 — or `bpm` with an optional `offset_ms`. `mode` picks the boundary, `action` picks how it gets there: `move` slides the whole clip and keeps its length, `trim` holds the opposite boundary and changes the length. A boundary further than `tolerance_ms` from every beat is left where it is and reported with the reason, so read the per-clip result rather than assuming everything moved.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

targets.description: Clip ids or names, or "all". Default: every clip on the sequence.

onsets_ms.description: Absolute beat times in ms. Exactly one of this and `bpm`.

bpm.description: Tempo. The grid is generated far enough to reach every target.

offset_ms.description: Where beat one sits, in ms. Default 0.

tolerance_ms.description: How far a boundary may travel to reach a beat. Default 60ms.

mode.description: Which boundary lands on a beat. Default "start".

action.description: "move" slides the clip, "trim" changes its length. Default "move".

name: ui_timeline_split_clip
description: Cut a clip in two at the given time (the razor tool). `atMs` is an absolute time on the timeline and must fall inside the clip; omit it to split at the current playhead. Returns the two resulting halves.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_stagger_animations
description: Offset existing animations across clips in the order listed. clip_ids are ordered clip IDs, not names. Each clip's animation delay increases by its zero-based index times offset_ms; media timing stays fixed. Every clip must have an animation.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

name: ui_timeline_transpose_clip
description: Move every note in a midi clip by whole semitones (12 = one octave). A note pushed past the 0..127 MIDI range is held at the end rather than dropped, so transposing up and back down does not always return the same phrase.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

clip.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

semitones.description: Whole semitones to move every note by. 12 is an octave up, -12 an octave down.

name: ui_timeline_trim_clip
description: Trim a clip's length or its source in/out points. `durationMs` sets the on-timeline length; `inPointMs`/`outPointMs` set the trimmed source window (ms into the source media). Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

target.description: Clip id, clip name (case-insensitive), or the literal "selected" for the currently-selected clip.

name: ui_timeline_update_beat
description: Change one beat of the plan, by its id or its 1-based position. Only the fields you pass are touched; pass an empty `voiceover` to drop the line and `transition: null` to make the beat a straight cut. Editing a beat never touches a clip that was already generated from it.

timeline_id.description: Id of the target timeline sequence.

beat.description: A beat id, or its 1-based position as a string ("3").
